d:
A shocking murder case has come to light from Delhi's Moti Nagar, where the body of an 18-year-old woman named Shabnam was found inside a clothing store.
CCTV footage reportedly shows the accused, Suraj, assaulting Shabnam inside the shop.
The footage allegedly captures him dragging her by her hair towards the changing room and shutting the door.
The incident has raised serious questions about women's safety at workplaces and the circumstances surrounding the murder.
